clap_push_up.name: Clap push-ups
clap_push_up.cue: Explode off the floor, land soft with bent elbows.

archer_push_up.name: Archer push-ups
archer_push_up.cue: Shift onto one arm, the other stays straight out.

pseudo_planche_push_up.name: Pseudo-planche push-ups
pseudo_planche_push_up.cue: Hands by the hips, lean well past the hands.

one_arm_push_up.name: One-arm push-ups
one_arm_push_up.cue: Feet wide, hips square, chest to the fist.

one_arm_push_up_tempo.name: One-arm push-ups, 4 s down
one_arm_push_up_tempo.cue: Four full seconds down, pause, drive up.

dip.name: Dips
dip.cue: Shoulders down, 90° at the elbow, lock out.

tempo_dip.name: Tempo dips (4 s down, 2 s pause)
tempo_dip.cue: Slow down, pause at the bottom, drive up.

elevated_pike_push_up.name: Elevated pike push-ups
elevated_pike_push_up.cue: Feet on a chair, hips high, head to the floor.

wall_handstand_push_up.name: Wall handstand push-ups
wall_handstand_push_up.cue: Head to a triangle with the hands, full lockout.

deficit_handstand_push_up.name: Deficit wall handstand push-ups
deficit_handstand_push_up.cue: Hands on books, lower the head below hand level.

push_up_drop_set.name: Drop set: archer → diamond → regular push-ups
push_up_drop_set.cue: Reps per part, no rest between.

chest_to_bar_pull_up.name: Chest-to-bar pull-ups
chest_to_bar_pull_up.cue: Pull the chest to the bar, elbows back.

explosive_pull_up.name: Explosive high pull-ups
explosive_pull_up.cue: Pull as high as you can, hands leave the bar if you can.

archer_pull_up.name: Archer pull-ups
archer_pull_up.cue: Pull to one hand, the other arm straight along the bar.

typewriter_pull_up.name: Typewriter pull-ups
typewriter_pull_up.cue: Up, slide side to side at the top, down.

muscle_up.name: Muscle-ups
muscle_up.cue: False grip if you like, clean transition, no kipping.

slow_muscle_up.name: Slow muscle-ups (3 s down)
slow_muscle_up.cue: Control the way down through the transition.

tempo_chin_up.name: Chin-ups, 4 s down
tempo_chin_up.cue: Chest to the bar, four seconds down.

l_sit_chin_up.name: L-sit chin-ups
l_sit_chin_up.cue: Legs straight out the whole set.

pull_up_drop_set.name: Drop set: archer → wide → regular pull-ups
pull_up_drop_set.cue: Reps per part, no rest between.

jump_squat.name: Jump squats
jump_squat.cue: Land soft, straight into the next rep.

shrimp_squat.name: Shrimp squats
shrimp_squat.cue: Hold the back foot, knee to the floor.

pistol_squat.name: Pistol squats
pistol_squat.cue: Heel down, arms forward, no bounce.

bulgarian_split_squat.name: Bulgarian split squats, 3 s down
bulgarian_split_squat.cue: Back foot on a chair, upright torso.

jumping_lunge.name: Jumping lunges
jumping_lunge.cue: Switch legs in the air, soft landing.

single_leg_calf_raise.name: Single-leg calf raises
single_leg_calf_raise.cue: Full stretch, pause at the top.

toes_to_bar.name: Toes-to-bar
toes_to_bar.cue: Toes touch the bar, controlled down.

hollow_body_hold.name: Hollow body hold
hollow_body_hold.cue: Lower back glued to the floor.

v_sit.name: V-sit attempts
v_sit.cue: From the L-sit, lift the legs higher.

chest_to_wall_handstand.name: Chest-to-wall handstand
chest_to_wall_handstand.cue: Belly to the wall, push the floor away, tight body.

toe_pull_handstand.name: Toe-pull handstand holds
toe_pull_handstand.cue: From the wall, pull the toes off and balance, 5-10 s each.

free_kick_up.name: Free kick-up attempts
free_kick_up.cue: Kick up away from the wall, find balance, bail safely.

free_handstand.name: Free-standing handstand
free_handstand.cue: Best of 5 tries. Fingers do the balancing.

one_arm_pull_up_archer_practice.name: One-arm pull-up practice: archer pull-ups
one_arm_pull_up_archer_practice.cue: Two sets, stop 2 reps before failure.

one_arm_pull_up_typewriter_practice.name: One-arm pull-up practice: typewriters
one_arm_pull_up_typewriter_practice.cue: Two sets, slow at the sides.

towel_assisted_one_arm_pull_up.name: Towel-assisted one-arm pull-ups
towel_assisted_one_arm_pull_up.cue: Other hand on a towel low down, help as little as you can.

one_arm_pull_up_negative.name: One-arm pull-up negatives (5 s)
one_arm_pull_up_negative.cue: Get to the top with both, lower on one arm for 5 s.

one_arm_pull_up.name: One-arm pull-ups
one_arm_pull_up.cue: Dead hang, pull with one arm, other hand free.

challenge: Quick set, then back to it.
Strength is a habit. Let's build it.
protein: Protein check: did you hit your target today?
bedtime: Bedtime soon: muscle grows while you sleep.
